bioghist.head: Biographical/Historical Information
bioghist.p: James (Jim) Edward Lincoln was born in Juneau, Alaska on June 21, 1898. The correspondence suggests that he came to live in Charlottesville late in his life. He was an artist and had connections with some artists and galleries. He was in his late 90s when he died.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: This collection contains correspondence and some memorabilia.
